name: Mia Li
shortBio: Quality and manufacturing engineer on ProudTek's RFID engineering team; author byline on card materials, hotel key card and laundry-tag durability articles.
bio: Mia Li is a quality and manufacturing engineer on ProudTek's RFID engineering team, covering RFID card materials, hotel key card manufacturing, compliance (ISO, CE, RoHS) and laundry-tag durability. Mia's byline appears on ProudTek's materials and hotel key card articles; standards claims in those articles are verified against the issuing standard and cited in each article's sources block.
